_role: Scout / light recon (Ferret, BRDM, Panhard register). Survivability by not being hit: low, slim, wedge-nosed, sloped all around, with the hull and superstructure nearly merging into one continuous slope. Per HULL_MASSING_SPEC.md it deliberately SKIPS the chunky sponson blisters the heavier hulls get - thin fender lips only - so it stays visually distinct from them.

primitives._note: Lower tub - low tub_frac (~0.45) so it stays proportionally low even under Y stretch, which is exactly the scout-car read.
Well-faired upper structure, only modestly narrower (upper_w ~0.8) so glacis and hull nearly merge.
Aggressive wedge nose - the defining silhouette cue for this class.
Thin left fender lip (NOT a deep sponson blister - see role note).
Small sensor/observation blister - scout identity, and keeps the top facet's centre clear for a pintle.
